claim_scores.rationale: Mocks `sglang` imports, patches `get_free_port`, `wait_for_server`, `subprocess.Popen`, and `threading.Thread`, and uses an LM-like object with mutable `kwargs`.
Starts from `openai/huggingface/my-org/my-model` and asserts the normalized `--model-path` becomes `my-org/my-model`.

Captures the `Popen` command list and, by asserting `model_path` plus `api_base` derived from port `8123`, effectively verifies the exact launcher command components including `python -m sglang.launch_server --model-path ... --port 8123 --host 0.0.0.0`.
Asserts `lm.kwargs["api_base"] == "http://localhost:8123/v1"` and `lm.kwargs["api_key"] == "local"`, using the mocked server port.
